title: Medical/Dental Office Starter Pack
client: Private Dental Practices, Med Spas, Chiropractors, Aesthetic Clinics
industry: Healthcare • Medical Practice Management • SMB Automation
challenge: Medical and dental practices struggle with manual patient intake, missed appointments, and fragmented workflows that create administrative burden and reduce patient satisfaction. Private dental practices, med spas, chiropractors, and aesthetic clinics waste hours on repetitive tasks: manually processing intake forms, tracking consent documents, coordinating appointments, managing missed visits, and following up on recurring care. Without automation, practices lose revenue from no-shows, face compliance risks from incomplete documentation, and spend valuable time on administrative work instead of patient care.
whyNow: Increasing patient expectations for seamless digital experiences
Need to reduce no-shows and missed appointments
Growing complexity in compliance and documentation requirements
Time wasted on manual intake and consent workflows
Missed revenue opportunities from incomplete follow-ups
Lack of automated systems for recurring care management
whyNowSummary: Medical and dental practices are losing revenue and patient satisfaction due to manual processes, missed appointments, and incomplete follow-ups. The healthcare industry demands efficient patient management, automated compliance workflows, and systems that ensure no patient falls through the cracks while freeing staff to focus on care delivery.
solution: A comprehensive medical/dental office automation starter pack that automates patient intake, consent workflows, appointment scheduling, missed visit recovery, and recurring care management. The system integrates intake forms with DocuSign for consent management, syncs with practice calendars for seamless scheduling, sends automated reminders, detects no-shows and offers rescheduling, tracks recurring visits, and triggers review/referral campaigns. Phase 2 adds AI-powered review and referral automation to drive patient acquisition.

phases.name: Phase 1 — New Patient Intake & Consent Workflow
delivered: Typeform/Google Form intake → auto-PDF → DocuSign
Folders created per patient (Drive/Dropbox) with audit trail
Optional: Flag incomplete consents for front desk follow-up
Automated consent tracking and compliance monitoring
Secure document storage with patient privacy compliance
phases.value: 70% faster intake processing, complete audit trail, reduced compliance risk, organized patient documentation, time saved on manual data entry

phases.name: Phase 2 — Appointment Scheduling + Missed Visit Recovery
delivered: Online form → syncs with Office calendar (Google/Outlook)
Sends SMS/email reminders automatically
If missed: follow-up text with "reschedule now" CTA
Two-way calendar sync for real-time availability
Automated confirmation and reminder sequences
phases.value: 40-50% reduction in no-show rate, improved patient satisfaction, automated recovery of missed appointments, seamless scheduling experience

phases.name: Phase 3 — Recurring Care & Membership Nudges
delivered: Tracks recurring visits (e.g. dental cleanings, Botox)
Sends automated "Time for your next visit!" reminders
Syncs with CRM to offer special discounts/packages
Personalized care reminders based on patient history
Automated membership renewal and package offers
phases.value: 30-40% improvement in recurring visit rate, increased patient retention, automated revenue recovery, personalized patient engagement

phases.name: Phase 4 — Review & Referral Bot (Bonus)
phases.purpose: Drive Patient Acquisition Through Reviews and Referrals
delivered: After 3rd visit, triggers Google/Yelp review request
Personalized referral code generation
Tracks referrals via unique links (Airtable or Sheet)
Automated follow-up for review completion
Referral reward tracking and fulfillment
phases.value: 3-5× increase in online reviews, automated referral tracking, improved online reputation, new patient acquisition through referrals

demoStory: New patient completes intake form → System creates PDF → Routes to DocuSign for consent → Patient signs → Completed documents auto-saved to patient folder → Front desk notified → Appointment scheduled via online form → System syncs to practice calendar → Automated reminders sent → If patient misses appointment, system detects no-show → Automatic reschedule offer sent via SMS → Patient reschedules → After 3rd visit, system triggers review request → Patient leaves review → Referral code generated → Patient shares code → New patient arrives → Referral tracked automatically → Practice grows through automated patient acquisition.

The starter pack eliminates administrative burden, ensures compliance, and enables staff to focus on what they do best: delivering exceptional patient care.
